findings.reason: the floor must be set from the measured population (5 runs / 3 pairs over 17 h) or the window extended, otherwise the node is dispatched to compute a verdict it cannot produce.
findings.text: the floor "at least 20 runs in the ledger window that were admitted with a file claim under a shared root while another live run held the same file" is above the population the fleet produces: over the whole after window to date (2026-11-09T07:39Z to now, ~17 h, wider than the 12 h minimum) the run ledger holds 141 runs, of which 121 are review nodes with only absolute out-of-repo report paths and no shared-root file claim; just 19 runs carried a shared-root file claim at all, and only 5 of those overlapped another live run on the same file (4 same-file concurrent pairs across 3 distinct run pairs) — so the floor can only ever report the zero as unmeasured, and §4 can never close

findings.reason: the floor must be counted inside the hours the copies actually cover, or the zero is "backed" by evidence of concurrency in a window in which nothing was observed.
findings.text: the zero is observed on the retained copies (about 4.5 h of coverage: 07:39–10:37Z and 20:46–22:12Z on 9 November) while its backing floor is counted over "at least 12 hours" of ledger after the 07:39Z reload, so a 12 h window ending 19:39Z excludes the 20:46–22:12Z copy entirely and, more generally, concurrency anywhere in the ledger window can back a zero taken in copied hours that held none

findings.reason: without excluding holds caused by an exclusive directory claim (and by an exclusive pattern under §2), the zero fails on behaviour the plan deliberately preserves, and the node reads a correct refusal as a regression.
findings.text: the numerator counts "held-on-claim verdicts on file claims ... split by whether the claimed path is under a shared root" with no exclusion for a hold that §2 keeps correct — §2 states "A directory claim stays exclusive, as it is today", so a file claim on a shared-root path whose holder is a live run claiming the enclosing directory is still refused, and that refusal lands in the zero's numerator as a failure of the shared-file default
